basic_info.description: High above the city in Ashbury Heights, this top floor condominium is an Edwardian charmer with breathtaking views.The spacious LR faces west, looking towards the Pacific Ocean and Headlands. Next to LR is FDR, another large space and entertainer's dream. Kitch is big enough for casual dining and opens to den. Views from Kitch and even bigger views from adjacent deck with outlooks of bay and GGBridge. Washer dryer in the unit. Huge storage space. Parking for two cars, s/s (depending on size). This property has it all! The street is quiet and location is near shopping/dining on Cole and Haight Streets. Many tech bus options. Buena Vista Park is up the hill and Golden Gate Park is easily accessible.
